physical.name: Physical
physical.desc: Move deals damage with the Attack and Defense stats.

special.name: Special
special.desc: Move deals damage with the Special Attack and Special Defense stats.

mythical.name: Mythical
mythical.desc: Legendaries usually only obtainable from events. Usually BST 600

sublegendary.name: Sub-Legendary
sublegendary.desc: Legendaries that aren't Restricted or Mythical. Usually BST 570 to 580.

restrictedlegendary.name: Restricted Legendary
restrictedlegendary.desc: Officially called Special Pokémon. Legendaries restricted from most in-game formats. Usually BST at least 660.

contact.name: Contact
contact.desc: Affected by a variety of moves, abilities, and items. Moves affected by contact moves include: Spiky Shield, King's Shield. Abilities affected by contact moves include: Iron Barbs, Rough Skin, Gooey, Flame Body, Static, Tough Claws. Items affected by contact moves include: Rocky Helmet, Sticky Barb.

sound.name: Sound
sound.desc: Doesn't affect Soundproof Pokémon. (All sound moves also bypass Substitute.)

powder.name: Powder
powder.desc: Doesn't affect Grass-type Pokémon, Overcoat Pokémon, or Safety Goggles holders.

bypassprotect.name: Bypass Protect
bypassprotect.desc: Bypasses Protect, Detect, King's Shield, and Spiky Shield.

nonreflectable.name: Nonreflectable
nonreflectable.desc: Can't be bounced by Magic Coat or Magic Bounce.

nonmirror.name: Nonmirror
nonmirror.desc: Can't be copied by Mirror Move.

bypasssubstitute.name: Bypass Substitute
bypasssubstitute.desc: Bypasses but does not break a Substitute.

past.name: Past
past.desc: Obtainable in a past game, but not in this game.

truepast.name: True Past
truepast.desc: Obtainable in a past game, but is not in this game's data at all, not even in Dexit placeholder form.

pastunobtainable.name: Past Unobtainable
pastunobtainable.desc: Existed in game data in a past game, but was never obtainable.

future.name: Future
future.desc: Obtainable in a future game, but is not in this game's data at all.

lgpe.name: LGPE
lgpe.desc: Obtainable in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! or Let's Go, Eevee!, but not in this game.

unobtainable.name: Unobtainable
unobtainable.desc: Exists in game data but not obtainable without hacking.

cap.name: CAP
cap.desc: Made up for the Smogon Create-A-Pokemon project.

custom.name: Custom
custom.desc: Made up for... something or other. I don't recommend using this, it's not tagged very consistently.

nonexistent.name: Nonexistent
nonexistent.desc: Does not exist in game data. Includes Past, Future, LGPE, CAP, and Custom.
